recommendation: Keep the audit commit. FHIR-14326 is satisfied by current source, and reverting to the literal historical low <= high expression would discard later approved refinements.
issue_request: FHIR-14326 was Published/Persuasive and asked to re-enable Range invariant 2 once FHIRPath had support for Quantity comparisons.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 11f97b11d79b7132747af46442affd51e3ef35e5 re-enabled rng-2 by changing the Range invariant id from !2 back to 2; although the commit subject names FHIR-14309, FHIR-14326 records the same svn revision 13459.
additional_context: FHIR-14194 temporarily disabled rng-2, FHIR-14308 supplied Quantity comparison support, and FHIR-14324 was a duplicate/background FHIRPath request. FHIR-25736 and FHIR-34417 later refined the expression while preserving the invariant.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/datatypes/range.xml already contains active invariant id 2 for Range with the requested human rule and a current low.value/high.value plus lowBoundary/highBoundary comparable expression.
